title: Event Produce | Orgiast's In-House Events & Creative Production
content_html:
When utilized effectively, in-house events and company events can become a catalyst for growth by invigorating internal communication, uniting the organization, and boosting employee motivation. Orgiast is a planning company specializing in in-house events and company events. We propose optimal in-house event plans that align with employee needs and awareness as well as the company's direction. To strengthen the relationship between employees and the company and unite the organization, it is necessary to create opportunities for the company and employees to "communicate (dialogue)." At Orgiast, we strengthen our clients' organizational capabilities through the following in-house event solutions.

Services

Exhibition Booth [Re:Booth (Re:ブース)]

A new exhibition booth that is environmentally friendly and reduces costs by manufacturing using reusable materials.
VR Event

From anywhere with just one smartphone! An online event held in a virtual space that can accommodate up to 5,000 participants. No venue or travel required, reducing costs!
General Meeting of Employees / In-House Event Production

An in-house event package that enhances employee loyalty (company spirit) and improves organizational strength.
Award System Consulting

Total support to maximize the effectiveness of an award system that leads to increased employee motivation.
Anniversary Event

We will propose events that make milestone anniversaries a celebration for all employees and unite the organization.
Listing Celebration Party

We create an experience that celebrates the precious moment of listing as a successful experience for all employees and strengthens momentum for further growth.
Venue & Equipment Arrangement

We can arrange venues from small/medium-scale to large-scale. We also arrange and set up the equipment necessary for the event.
Planning Consulting

We listen to your requests and budget, and propose a plan we recommend for your company.
Script & Manual Production

We create scripts and manuals to ensure the smooth progress of the event.
Video & Slide Production

We produce videos and slides to energize the event. Also recommended for online events.
Game Planning

Energize the event with employee participation game plans. Proposals for online events are also possible.
Venue Decoration

We propose a higher-grade event with venue decoration tailored to the event content. We also produce online backgrounds.
Catering Service

Meals can be arranged according to your preferences. We also offer delivery to individual homes for online events, etc.
MC & Talent Arrangement

We deliver the highest quality performance by professionals.
Web Conference & Webinar Support

We support online meetings such as Zoom, including slide creation and equipment setup.
Online General Meeting of Shareholders

We support general meetings of shareholders where shareholders can participate online.
Tsunagu Remote Funeral

Providing an opportunity for many people to say goodbye. A live streaming system for funeral services using cameras.
Telework Implementation Support

Can be set up using the company's existing computers and just one laptop! No visit required, setup can be completed online.
